comments:
Based on the lemmata, this is a commentary on the Pratimokṣa­sūtra­ṭīkā­vinaya­samuccaya (ID:7386), which addresses the portion corresponding to D4106, 129b4 to 142a6.
The text does not have a colophon.

The author makes numerous references (in the form "... na re" to the views of "rgya" (presumably rGya 'dul 'dzin (ID:3941)), which he refutes. Also cited are Sog (ID:3940), Khyung rin chen grags (ID:3809), gZus rdo rje rgyal mtshan (ID:6432) and the yet unidentified rKyang 'dul gar ston (ID:8637).
Ten references in the form "bya'i zhal nas" (for views that are not criticized) presumably refer to Bya 'dul 'dzin brtson 'grus 'bar (ID:3818). Also cited in this form is rMa tsho (ID:3942), Bya 'dul 'dzin's teacher, and "rtsis pa," presumably Bya 'dul's student gZhon nu seng ge (ID:3946), "rong pa" (maybe Bya 'dul's student gTsang rong pa lCe 'dul 'dzin (ID:3947)), and an anonymous "mkhan po chen po."

The author can thus be situated in the lineage of Bya 'dul, probably among his second- or third-generation students.
